title: Repository-native tested event model driven effect proof architecture

transition_contract.EVENT_to_EXACT_SUBJECT: bind event to exact commit HEAD and TREE before interpreting progress
transition_contract.EXACT_SUBJECT_to_ADMISSION: require repository-native admission evidence for that exact subject
transition_contract.ADMISSION_to_EXECUTION: require jobs to have actually executed; zero-job and action_required are not execution
transition_contract.EXECUTION_to_TEST: require tests and gates to execute on the exact subject
transition_contract.TEST_to_MUTATION: mutation is permitted only by an authorized bounded writer after its required gates
transition_contract.MUTATION_to_SUCCESSOR_HEAD_TREE: every mutation creates a successor with a new exact HEAD/TREE identity
transition_contract.SUCCESSOR_HEAD_TREE_to_FRESH_READBACK: read the persisted successor independently from the repository
transition_contract.FRESH_READBACK_to_SUCCESSOR_BECOMES_NEXT: only a successfully identity-bound readback advances the active subject
transition_contract.SUCCESSOR_BECOMES_NEXT_SUBJECT_to_TERMIN: repeat the same tested transition semantics until all terminal predicates hold
transition_contract.TERMINAL_CONJUNCTION_to_EFFECT_ACK_DONE: EFFECT_ACK_DONE is true only when every required terminal predicate is simultaneously evidenced

effect_ack_rule: EFFECT_ACK_DONE iff all terminal_conjunction predicates are simultaneously true for the active exact subject
continuation_rule: after a successful fresh readback, the observed successor becomes the next bound input subject; the predecessor remains historical evidence only
